title: C¹ maps on an open set send Hⁿ-null subsets to Lebesgue-null sets (parent step 1(c))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let Z ⊆ ℝ^P be open, F : ℝ^P → ℝ^n C¹ on Z (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F Z), and S ⊆ Z with H^n(S) = 0, where H^n = μHE[n] on ℝ^P. Then L^n(F(S)) = 0, where L^n = volume on ℝ^n = Euclid n.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Z S : Set (Euclid P)) (F : Euclid P → Euclid n), IsOpen Z → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F Z → S ⊆ Z → μHE[n] S = 0 → volume (F '' S) = 0
